?? Business Manager
?? Location: Bowhill, South Australia
?? Employment Type: Full-Time – Permanent


Bowhill Engineering is entering an exciting new stage of growth, and we're looking for an experienced and people-focused Business Manager to help lead the business through its next chapter.
This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role within a growing engineering and manufacturing business, helping strengthen our systems, support our people, and build the structure required to successfully grow from approximately 60 employees to 90+ and beyond.
Specialising in major infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill Engineering is powered by technology and driven by great people to optimise and build structures that matter.


About the Role
The Business Manager will provide leadership, coordination and accountability across our key business support functions, including Human Resources, Administration, WHSE and Finance.
Working closely with the CEO, senior leaders and support teams, you will become the central point of coordination that helps ensure communication is clear, priorities are aligned, systems continue to improve, and important initiatives are delivered successfully.
This role is not about doing everything yourself. It is about leading people, strengthening accountability, improving processes, supporting teams and ensuring the business operates efficiently while maintaining the practical, down-to-earth culture that makes Bowhill Engineering a great place to work.
You will help create the systems, structure and leadership pathways needed to support sustainable growth while preserving the values and culture that have made Bowhill Engineering successful.


Key Responsibilities
-Provide leadership and coordination across HR, Administration, WHSE and Finance support functions
-Act as the central point of contact for internal business support activities
-Support the CEO and Leadership Team by reducing day-to-day operational distractions
-Improve communication, clarity and accountability across teams
-Drive implementation of new systems, processes and business improvement initiatives
-Monitor business performance and ensure key priorities are followed through
-Build capability within support teams through coaching, guidance and leadership
-Strengthen succession planning and reduce key-person dependencies
-Support business growth by developing scalable systems and structures
-Foster a positive workplace culture aligned with Bowhill Engineering's values

About You
You enjoy bringing order to complexity and helping people succeed.
You are practical, organised and commercially minded, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on leadership. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments and know how to achieve results through collaboration and accountability.
You may come from a business management, operations, HR, finance, administration or leadership background. Most importantly, you understand how businesses operate and can bring people, systems and priorities together to achieve positive outcomes.
You will be:
-Highly organised, practical and reliable
-A strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
-Commercially aware with sound financial understanding
-Confident leading people and managing accountability
-Calm under pressure and able to prioritise effectively
-Comfortable working with both senior leaders and frontline teams
-Respectful, humble and solutions-focused
-A proactive problem solver who takes ownership and follows through
-Adaptable and quick to learn new systems and processes

Skills & Experience
-Qualification in Business, Management, Human Resources, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline (desirable)
-Demonstrated experience in a senior business, operations, administration, HR, finance or management role
-Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, reporting and business performance
-Proven leadership experience with the ability to coordinate teams and drive accountability
-Experience implementing and improving systems, processes and business initiatives
-Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills
-Strong computer literacy including Microsoft Office and business management systems
-Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced and growing environment

What We Offer
-A key leadership role within a growing and ambitious organisation
-Opportunity to help shape the future direction of the business
-Direct collaboration with the CEO and Leadership Team
-Long-term career growth and development opportunities
-Annual wage reviews and professional development support
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Employee Health Assistance
-Active Social Club and strong team culture
-Modern workplace and supportive environment
-Enjoy the River Murray lifestyle
-Join an Employer of Choice in the Murraylands

Why Bowhill Engineering?
At Bowhill Engineering, culture matters.
We value honesty, humility, teamwork, respect and doing what we say we're going to do. We are proud of the projects we deliver, the people we employ and the communities we support.
This is an opportunity to step into a meaningful leadership role and help shape the next chapter of Bowhill Engineering while ensuring we continue to grow without losing what makes us unique.


How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via our website

With the recent installation and commissioning of three state-of-the-art IGM Robotic Welding Systems at Bowhill Engineering, we are growing our Robotics Team & seek an additional Robotic Welder Operator


This is an exciting & unique
opportunity to work with world-class technology in our new B5 Fabrication Hall, contributing to the production of over 660 precision-engineered steel tunnel segments for the Torrens to Darlington
Project & future heavy structural steel projects.


Specialising in large government infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill
Engineering is powered by technology, driven by great people to optimize and build structures that matter.


About the Role
Advancing Bowhill Engineering’s robotic capabilities, a blend of technical skills, knowledge of welding processes, and familiarity with robotic programming and maintenance is key to success in this role.


Through the daily operating, maintaining, and programming you will ensure efficient, high-quality welds & products and look to increase cost effectiveness of manufacturing operations of our robotic welding systems. Proficiency with CAD software or similar tools, experience in quality control, and understanding of safety protocols are highly beneficial.


Sharing our big picture focus, on enhancing production efficiency, implementing improvements and increasing our robotic capabilities, you will play a key role in operating advanced robotic welding
cells, deliver high performance & specialized welding requirements to produce high-quality fabrication outcomes.


Key Responsibilities & Requirements
Ability to operate fully automated robotic welding systemsCapability to develop advanced offline and online welding programsStrong fault-finding and troubleshooting skillsStrong work ethic and commitment to quality

Trade Certification (Welding or Fabrication) or relevant on-the-job welding experienceExperience reading and interpreting engineering drawingsHigh Risk Forklift Licence (highly desirable)

Key Solutions Group is based in the Paget precinct in Mackay, Queensland and is perfectly positioned to service clients from all over the local region and out to the Coal fields. With a long and proud history in the area and working with an extensive list of clients from all tiers of business, Key Solutions Group is the perfect partner for all your engineering needs.

With a proven end-to-end solution that includes design, draft, certification, fabrication and on-site installation, the highly qualified and experienced team at Key Solutions Group will work closely with you to deliver each project on time, on budget and to the high standard we are known for.

We are currently seeking experienced PAINTERS to join our team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Understand surface preparation and finishes.
Be able to understand and complete works to specifications.
Be able to mix to correct ratio two-part paint coatings etc.
Select paints, varnishes and stains to various surfaces using brushes, sprays, and rollers.
Understand the use of Wet Film Thickness Gauges and be able to achieve specified dry film thickness.
Be able to work at heights and in confined spaces.
Erecting scaffolding and ladders.
Cleaning equipment and work areas.

Desirable traits and will highly be regarded:
Trade Certificate –Certificate III in Surface Preparation or equivalent (for Blaster/Painters)
Construction Induction (White or Blue Card)
High Risk Licence for EWP and/or Forklift
Trade Qualifications in Protective Coatings (ACA, NACE, ICorr, or other trade certs)
HR licence, high risk licence with EWP and Forklift
Drivers Licence (MR or HR class)

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
With tight attention to detail
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

ABOUT US  
 
Fetch Personnel are an Australian owned recruitment company with 10 years’ experience specialising in Contract and Labour Hire across Commercial, Industrial and Residential Construction, plus major Civil Infrastructure Projects throughout Australia. 
 
 THE OPPORTUNITY  
 
Due to internal promotions and high client demand we are looking to add  2 Consultants  to our established  Labour Hire  team, which has grown to become one of the leading divisions here at Fetch. 
 
Demonstrated minimum of two years recruitment experience and/or equivalent qualifications are required as you will be managing a  Warm/Live  360 desk within either the  Construction  or  Civil Infrastructure  industry. 
 
We are a proven industry leader in our chosen fields, with have a large database of candidates, clients, with live jobs to work on from day 1. 
 
Key responsibilities include but not limited to: 

 
	 Manage recruitment process from start to finish for both Client and Candidate. 
	 Utilising various candidate sourcing strategies to successfully attract applicants. 
	 Qualify candidate suitability and client commitment for current or future vacancies. 
	 Maintain and develop current client relationships 
 

  
We are looking for people who are career driven, resilient and have good business acumen. A natural engaging approach, strong written and verbal communication skills are a must. If you are looking to drive your own business but want the support to achieve this, then this is the opportunity you have been waiting for.

Echo Marine Group is an Australian owned and operated company with over 10 years' experience in the Marine Industry. We specialise in the manufacture of Luxury Superyachts and Commercial Workboats. We also carry out maintenance on a full range of vessels in the Superyacht, Workboat and Defence areas.
Due to the increased workload and new upcoming projects, we are looking for enthusiastic and proactive Fitters to join our Engineering Team. So if you are looking for full time employment and have the necessary skills of a Pipe Fitter or Marine Fitter this may be the role for you!
About the Position:
What work will you be doing?
•	Installation of machinery and piping systems into vessels under construction or during maintenance/refit works.
•	Fabrication of piping systems to be installed into vessels, being worked on at Echo Marine.
•	Installation of marine power plants, shafting and auxiliary systems (Note no engine mechanical works is carried out by Echo Marine).
Who are we looking for?
To be successful for this position, you must ideally possess some of the following skills:
•	Marine Fitting experience preferred however, aligned trades including hydraulic piping installation, sprinkler installers or Plumbers will also be considered
•	Be able to read and understand drawings to construct systems and equipment into vessels under construction or maintenance
•	Pipe fabrication including working with stainless and copper nickel.
•	TIG Welding skills, with thin wall tube (1.5mm) experience would be an advantage.
•	Manual tube bending and flaring of tube up to 32mm in diameter.
What we can offer you!!
In return for your skills and experience, Echo Marine Group can offer:
•	Weekly pay
•	4-day 38hr week (Monday – Thursday 5.55am to 3.55pm)
•	Overtime rates apply outside these times and after 38hrs completed)
•	Waterfront location
•	Great small team environment where you are not just a number
•	Interesting and rewarding work
In return for your extensive skills and experience, Echo Marine Group can offer a salary range $39-$45 per hour excluding Super and penalties.
If this sounds like you, please click “APPLY NOW” with your resume and a cover letter.
Only those successfully shortlisted will be contacted.
Echo Marine Group is an equal opportunity employer.

result.description:
Austmin Development Pty Ltd, is a leader in the dimension stone industry and is seeking a highly motivated, safety-focused, and experienced Mine Deputy to join our dynamic team. This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant operation of our granite quarry. If you are a professional with a proven track record in surface mining and a passion for operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:


Safety & Compliance (Primary Focus):
• Enforce all company safety policies, procedures, and MSHA (Mine Safety and Health Administration) regulations without exception.
• Conduct pre-shift safety inspections of the pit, equipment, and work areas, documenting and correcting hazards promptly.
• Lead safety meetings and training sessions for crew members.
• Investigate all accidents, incidents, and near-misses, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
• Maintain all required safety and production records in accordance with state and federal laws.

  Operational Excellence:
• Directly supervise quarry personnel and daily mining activities, including drilling, loading, and hauling.
• Oversee the extraction of granite blocks, ensuring quality standards are met.
• Collaborate with the Quarry Manager to develop and execute short-range mining plans.
• Monitor equipment performance and coordinate with maintenance teams to minimise downtime.
• Optimise production processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

  Leadership & Team Development:
• Provide direct supervision, guidance, and mentorship to equipment operators and other quarry staff.
• Foster a positive, accountable, and proactive team culture centered on safety and quality.
• Assist in scheduling, assigning tasks, and evaluating crew performance.
 

 Required Qualifications & Certifications:


• A minimum of 5 years of experience in a surface mining environment, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
• Strong understanding of quarry operations, including drilling and heavy equipment (e.g., excavators, loaders).
• Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
• Ability to work in a physically demanding outdoor environment in all weather conditions.

What We Offer:


• A competitive salary from $160,000 per annum plus superannuation is commensurate, and a performance-based bonus structure.
• Formal education in Mining Engineering, Geology, or a related field.
• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within a growing company.
• A company culture that prioritises the well-being of its employees.
